 Al Nassr vs Al Kholood: Confirmed line ups and teams
 Team news as Al Nassr host Al Kholood in the Saudi Pro League
 Ben Miller 
 • 
 Last Update:
 19 minutes ago
 • 
 2 min read
 Al-Nassr and Al-Kholood have named their starting sides for their Saudi Pro League meeting at Al-Awwal Park on Friday.
 The reigning Saudi Pro League champions are on a four-match winning run in all competitions following their 3-1 win at Al-Faisaly on Friday.
 Ange Postecoglou’s team are two points behind leaders Al-Hilal with each of the top two having played 10 league games this season.
 Al-Kholood took 12 points from their first six league games of the campaign but are now 10th, having suffered a fourth straight defeat with a 3-0 loss at home to Al-Ettifaq on Saturday.
 Now it feels like matchday 👀💛 pic.twitter.com/DnkOFzr7by 
— AlNassr FC (@AlNassrFC_EN) October 29, 2026 
 Al Nassr confirmed team vs Al Kholood
 Al-Nassr starting XI: Bento, Nawaf Boushal, Mohamed Simakan, Inigo Martinez, Ayman Yahya, Abdullah Al-Khaibari, Abdullah Al-Hamdan, Sadio Mane, Joao Felix, Cristiano Ronaldo, Angelo Gabriel
 Al-Nassr substitutes: Abdulhadi Al Alwan, Abdulelah Al Amri, Saad Al Nasser, Hayder Abdulkareem, Sami Al Naji, Abdulrahman Ghareeb, Rakan Al Ghamdi, Awad Aman, Salem Al Najdi
 Al Kholood full line up vs Al Nassr
 Al-Kholood: Hamed Al Shanqiti, Ramzi Solan, Shaquille Pinas, Mansour Camara, Sultan Al Shehri, Abdulrahman Al Dosari, John Buckley, Iker Kortajarena, Antoin Essomba, Julien Domingues, Coba da Costa
 Substitutes: Mohammed Al Shammari, Yazan Madani, Odai Slimani, Yaseen Al Zubaidi, Abdulrahman Al Obaid, Muhannad Al Yahya, Mohammed Al Rashdi, Muhammad Sawaan, Guga
 Where to watch Al Nassr vs Al Kholood: TV channel, live online streams
 This match is not being shown live in the UK.
